titulo_es.@en: Assess the effect · Urban planning and mobility

texto.@es: Las propuestas urbanas equilibran movilidad, ruido, coste y acceso. Revisa qué grupo o zona se beneficia, qué inconveniente se reconoce y qué medida se propone para mitigarlo.
texto.@en: Urban proposals balance mobility, noise, cost and access. Check which group or area benefits, which inconvenience is recognized and what measure is proposed to mitigate it.

texto.@es: Compara las dos pistas y distingue lo que el texto dice de lo que solo parece sugerir.
texto.@en: Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
